title: Order jumps in Spectral Deferred Corrections
summary: Spectral deferred corrections (SDC) are time-stepping schemes were a low-order integrator is used iteratively to produce a higher order numerical approximation. SDC methods are well-known to obtain at least one additional order of accuracy per iteration. We analyse the phenomenon of "order jumps", which were observed experimentally in previous work, where the order increases by two in a single iteration.
